source_routes.name: Broadband USO: what you need to know
Mobile coverage checker frequently asked questions
Broadband and mobile coverage checker and API

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The Spring 2026 update is a snapshot of fixed availability and mobile coverage as of January 2026.
Ofcom used the report collection to update its broadband and mobile coverage checkers.

guard_streams.write_limit: A checker refresh does not establish exact archive bytes or parcel evidence.

facts.detail: Every UK home and business has the legal right to request a decent affordable broadband connection subject to eligibility.
A decent connection requires at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload.

guard_streams.write_limit: A statutory threshold is not an observed speed for a task row.

facts.detail: Requests are made to BT, or KCOM in the Hull area.
An applicant does not need to be an existing BT or KCOM customer.

guard_streams.write_limit: Provider eligibility does not prove coverage absence or availability at a parcel.

facts.detail: Eligibility requires no access to an existing decent broadband service.
The property must not be due coverage from a UK or devolved-government public broadband scheme in the next 12 months.

guard_streams.write_limit: USO eligibility must not be inferred from incomplete postcode coverage fields.

facts.detail: A property with only a decent service priced above £59.60 per month can request a universal-service connection.
The resulting broadband package must cost no more than £59.60 per month.

guard_streams.write_limit: Affordability is a consumer eligibility rule, not a coverage percentage.

facts.detail: BT or KCOM has 30 days to confirm eligibility and the estimated build cost.
Where excess costs are accepted, a survey and quote are provided within 60 days.

guard_streams.write_limit: Administrative timing does not change the January 2026 coverage snapshot.

facts.detail: If the applicant's share of build or upgrade cost is £3,400 or less, the applicant does not pay that construction cost.
If the cost exceeds £3,400, the applicant may proceed by paying the excess.

guard_streams.write_limit: Cost treatment cannot be used to fabricate availability or speed.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom broadband USO guidance and Spring 2026

facts.detail: An existing fixed-wireless or satellite service may provide a decent or faster connection and affect USO eligibility.
Ofcom notes that wireless and satellite rollout has reduced the number of properties unable to obtain decent broadband.

guard_streams.write_limit: Technology availability must be proven for the exact location rather than assumed nationally.

facts.detail: Lower-priced Starlink packages were available only in selected parts of the UK and marketed as residential products.
Around 7,000 commercial premises were excluded from the USO estimate because some may already have connectivity such as leased lines.

guard_streams.write_limit: Satellite affordability and commercial exclusions cannot populate exact fixed-line coverage fields.

facts.detail: Vodafone and Three submitted separate coverage-prediction datasets and remain separately reported until fully integrated.
Separate submissions prohibit treating the two networks as one combined current-coverage source.

guard_streams.write_limit: Operator integration status cannot alter fixed-postcode values.

facts.detail: Headline gigabit-capable and full-fibre coverage reporting focuses on residential properties.
Full-fibre take-up and premises without decent broadband are reported for residential and commercial premises combined, while all-premises coverage is available in interactive and download products.

guard_streams.write_limit: Metrics with different premise populations must not be merged.

facts.detail: Ofcom performs real-world sample testing and finds operator model predictions generally reliable.
Predictions cannot guarantee coverage at a specific location because trees, buildings, foliage and other local factors can change experience within a grid area.

guard_streams.write_limit: A model prediction is not guaranteed parcel-level service.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom checker pages and canonical workflow evidence

facts.detail: Ofcom aims to update checker predictions every three months or with Connected Nations; developer data is available through an API, but the checker does not report maintenance or temporary faults.
The current-HEAD workflow search returned zero PR-triggered runs, and the task retained zero candidate, measured-speed or accuracy promotions.

guard_streams.write_limit: Checker/API availability and absent workflow evidence cannot satisfy exact r2 acceptance.
